# Pull Request — Awesome Cyber Security Heaven

Thanks for helping curate the list! A few quick checks before we merge:

## What kind of change is this?
- [ ] Adding a new tool
- [ ] Fixing a broken link / outdated entry
- [ ] Improving descriptions or structure
- [ ] Other

## The four heaven rules (for new tools)
- [ ] **Free** — free or functional free tier (not trial-only)
- [ ] **Licensed** — OSI or clearly stated license, noted in the entry
- [ ] **Maintained** — activity within the last 12 months
- [ ] **Useful** — genuinely useful for security work, not a duplicate

## Entry format checklist
- [ ] Added in the correct realm section
- [ ] One line per tool: `- [Name](url) — what it does. (License)`
- [ ] Sorted to keep the section tidy
- [ ] No marketing language — factual descriptions only

## Anything else reviewers should know?
